title: Making a Short Phone Call
situation: A caller phones a clinic and asks to speak to reception.
somali_situation: Qof wacaya ayaa telefoon u diraya xarun caafimaad wuxuuna codsanayaa inuu la hadlo soo-dhoweynta.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: Hello, Ahmed. How can I help?
dialogue.somali: Hallow, Axmed. Sideen kuu caawin karaa?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: You are speaking to reception now.

dialogue.speaker: Caller
dialogue.english: I need to change my appointment.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan u baahanahay inaan ballantayda beddelo.

title: Sending a Text Message
somali_title: Farriin qoraal ah oo la dirayo
situation: Two friends use text messages to confirm where to meet.
somali_situation: Laba saaxiib ayaa farriimo qoraal ah u isticmaalaya inay xaqiijiyaan meesha ay ku kulmayaan.
key_phrases: Did you get my text message?
I will reply in a minute.
Let us meet outside the cafe.
I may be ten minutes late.

dialogue.speaker: Friend A
dialogue.english: Did you get my text message?

dialogue.speaker: Friend B
dialogue.english: Yes, but the address is not clear.

dialogue.speaker: Friend B
dialogue.english: I will reply in a minute.

dialogue.speaker: Friend A
dialogue.english: Let us meet outside the cafe.

dialogue.speaker: Friend B
dialogue.english: Good. Send a message when you arrive.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Farriin dir markaad timaaddo.

dialogue.speaker: Friend A
dialogue.english: I may be ten minutes late.
dialogue.somali: Waxaa laga yaabaa inaan toban daqiiqo soo daaho.

dialogue.speaker: Friend B
dialogue.english: That is fine. I will wait.
dialogue.somali: Taasi waa hagaag. Waan sugi doonaa.

dialogue.speaker: Friend A
dialogue.somali: Waad ku mahadsan tahay inaad dhaqso uga jawaabtay.

title: Writing a Polite Email
somali_title: Iimayl edeb leh oo la qorayo
situation: A learner asks a coworker to check a short email before sending it.
somali_situation: Arday ayaa shaqaale kale ka codsanaya inuu eego iimayl gaaban ka hor inta aan la dirin.
key_phrases: Can you check this email before I send it?

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Can you check this email before I send it?
dialogue.somali: Iimaylkan ma hubin kartaa ka hor inta aanan dirin?

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Does the greeting sound too formal?
dialogue.somali: Salaantu ma u muuqataa mid aad rasmi u ah?

dialogue.speaker: Coworker
dialogue.somali: Maya, weedhani waxay u muuqataa edeb.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Good. I want the email to be friendly.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Waxaan rabaa iimaylku inuu noqdo mid saaxiibtinimo leh.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Thank you. I will add it now.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Hadda ayaan ku dari doonaa.

dialogue.speaker: Coworker
dialogue.english: Also say, please reply by Friday.
dialogue.somali: Sidoo kale dheh, fadlan ka jawaab Jimcaha ka hor.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.somali: Fadlan ka jawaab Jimcaha ka hor.

dialogue.speaker: Coworker
dialogue.somali: Taasi si fiican bay u shaqaynaysaa.

title: Speaking Up in a Meeting
situation: A team member contributes in a meeting, asks for clarification, and agrees on next steps.
somali_situation: Xubin kooxeed ayaa shir wax ku biirinaya, wuxuu codsanayaa caddayn, wuxuuna ku heshiiyaa tallaabooyinka xiga.
key_phrases: Can I add one point to the agenda?
Let us agree on the next step.
I will share notes after the meeting.

dialogue.speaker: Team Member
dialogue.english: Can I add one point to the agenda?
dialogue.somali: Hal qodob ma ku dari karaa ajandaha?

dialogue.speaker: Team Member
dialogue.english: The new schedule may affect customer calls.
dialogue.somali: Jadwalka cusub wuxuu saamayn karaa wicitaannada macaamiisha.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.english: That is important. What change do you suggest?
dialogue.somali: Taasi waa muhiim. Isbeddel noocee ah ayaad soo jeedinaysaa?

dialogue.speaker: Team Member
dialogue.english: We should keep one person on the phone desk.
dialogue.somali: Waa inaan hal qof ku haynaa miiska telefoonka.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.somali: Waqtiga kama dambaysta ah ma caddayn kartaa?

dialogue.speaker: Team Member
dialogue.english: We need the plan by Thursday.
dialogue.somali: Qorshaha waxaan u baahanahay Khamiista ka hor.

dialogue.speaker: Team Member
dialogue.english: Yes, so we should tell everyone today.
dialogue.somali: Haa, markaa waa inaan qof walba maanta u sheegnaa.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.english: Let us agree on the next step.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.english: I will review it before lunch.
dialogue.somali: Qadada ka hor ayaan dib u eegi doonaa.

dialogue.speaker: Team Member
dialogue.english: Good. That keeps the meeting focused.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Taasi shirku diiradda ayay ku haynaysaa.

dialogue.speaker: Team Member
dialogue.english: I will share notes after the meeting.
dialogue.somali: Shirka ka dib qoraallada ayaan wadaagi doonaa.

dialogue.speaker: Manager
dialogue.english: Thank you. That will help everyone.
dialogue.somali: Mahadsanid. Taasi qof walba way caawin doontaa.

title: Following Simple Instructions
situation: A learner follows simple instructions for using a copy machine.
somali_situation: Arday ayaa raacaya tilmaamo fudud oo lagu isticmaalayo mashiinka nuqulka.
key_phrases: Please give me one instruction at a time.
Put the paper in the machine.
I can follow the instructions now.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: Please give me one instruction at a time.
dialogue.somali: Fadlan hal tilmaam mar kasta ii sheeg.

dialogue.speaker: Office Worker
dialogue.english: Put the paper in the machine.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.english: I can follow the instructions now.

dialogue.speaker: Office Worker
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Nuqulkii waa diyaar.

title: Asking Questions in Class
situation: A learner asks a teacher clear questions during an English class.
somali_situation: Arday ayaa macallin ku weydiinaya su'aalo cad inta lagu jiro fasal Ingiriisi ah.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.english: Of course. What is your question?

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.english: I have a doctor's appointment tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.somali: Ballan waxay ka dhigan tahay kulan la qorsheeyay.

dialogue.speaker: Learner
dialogue.somali: Su'aalo weydiintu waxay iga caawisaa inaan barto.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Fasalka ku sii weydii.

title: Giving Contact Information
situation: A patient gives contact information at reception and corrects one detail.
somali_situation: Bukaan ayaa soo-dhoweynta ku bixinaya macluumaad xiriir wuxuuna saxayaa hal faahfaahin.
key_phrases: I need to give you my information.
Thank you for giving the details.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: I need to give you my information.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan u baahanahay inaan ku siiyo macluumaadkayga.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: Please say the new address slowly.
dialogue.somali: Fadlan cinwaanka cusub si tartiib ah u sheeg.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Yes, it is a dot ali at mail dot com.
dialogue.somali: Haa, waa a dhibic ali at mail dhibic com.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.english: Yes, the phone number is correct.

dialogue.speaker: Patient
dialogue.somali: Wax kale ma u baahan tahay?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.english: Thank you for giving the details.
dialogue.somali: Waad ku mahadsan tahay faahfaahinta aad bixisay.

title: Confirming a Delivery Message
situation: A customer and courier confirm a delivery message, address, and arrival time.
somali_situation: Macmiil iyo qof keenis sameeya ayaa xaqiijinaya farriin keenis, cinwaan, iyo waqtiga imaatinka.
key_phrases: I am calling to confirm the delivery message.
The arrival time is between two and four.

dialogue.speaker: Courier
dialogue.english: Hello. I am calling to confirm the delivery message.
dialogue.somali: Hallow. Waxaan wacayaa inaan xaqiijiyo farriinta keenista.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Yes, I received the message this morning.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: It is 22 River Road, apartment five.

dialogue.speaker: Courier
dialogue.somali: Taasi waxay la mid tahay cinwaanka keenista.

dialogue.speaker: Courier
dialogue.english: The arrival time is between two and four.
dialogue.somali: Waqtiga imaatinku waa inta u dhexeysa laba iyo afar.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: I will be home after one thirty.
dialogue.somali: Waxaan guriga joogi doonaa hal iyo bar ka dib.

dialogue.speaker: Courier
dialogue.english: Yes, please sign when I arrive.
dialogue.somali: Haa, fadlan saxiix marka aan imaado.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Can you call before you come upstairs?
dialogue.somali: Ma wici kartaa ka hor intaadan kor iman?

dialogue.speaker: Courier
dialogue.english: Yes, I will call from the lobby.
dialogue.somali: Haa, hoolka hoose ayaan ka wici doonaa.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.english: Good. That helps me be ready.
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Taasi waxay iga caawisaa inaan diyaar noqdo.

dialogue.speaker: Courier
dialogue.english: I will send one more message when I am close.
dialogue.somali: Markaan dhowahay farriin kale ayaan diri doonaa.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.somali: Waad ku mahadsan tahay xiriirka cad.

title: Joining an Online Class
somali_title: Fasal internet ah oo lagu biirayo
situation: A learner joins an online class and checks the microphone and chat.
somali_situation: Arday ayaa ku biiraya fasal internet ah wuxuuna hubinayaa makarafoonka iyo chat-ka.
key_phrases: Use the chat if you need help.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Ma i maqli kartaa?

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.english: Use the chat if you need help.
dialogue.somali: Isticmaal chat-ka haddii aad caawimaad u baahan tahay.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.somali: Waa fiican tahay. Xiriirka internetku wuu cad yahay.
